name: How does a family room addition differ from a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does a family room addition differ from a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A family room addition specifically expands your home's footprint by adding new living space, focusing on creating a dedicated functional area. A whole-home remodel, conversely, renovates existing spaces throughout the entire house to improve flow and update aesthetics. While both enhance functionality and value, an addition increases square footage, whereas a remodel transforms existing space. AKN Design Group specializes in both, ensuring a coordinated transformation regardless of project type.
acceptedAnswer.description: An addition expands square footage for new space, while a whole-home remodel renovates existing areas to improve flow and update aesthetics.
